insight: For the Light Runners first playable, player collision radius is fixed at 2 m and is not exposed to hosts or designers; live-tail radius remains the only collision-thickness control, and tracking uncertainty stays separate.

Subsystem tests passed while production composition retained Null services and presentation events had multiple mutation owners. Runtime bootstrap, one accepted GateDirector path, typed crash events, and MatchManager-owned score/replay mutation restored the local match loop.

Persisting a match row at BeginMatch creates an unavoidable orphan on process death. This project should persist create, standings, and finalization as one stable-UUID PostgreSQL transaction at match end, queue it before dispatch, and flush only after authentication restores the JWT.
